settings.title: Get in Touch
settings.subtitle: Have questions? We're here to help. Get in touch with our friendly customer service team.
settings.address: NicPowch Ltd, 123 High Street, London, UK

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 1pm are dispatched same day. Standard UK delivery takes 1-3 business days.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 14 days of delivery for unopened products in original packaging.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We currently ship within the UK only. International shipping is coming soon.

settings.question: Why do I need age verification?
settings.answer: Nicotine pouches are an age-restricted product. UK law requires us to verify all customers are 18+.
